description: Image Description: The image depicts a serene winter scene in a forested mountainous area, with snow-covered evergreen trees and a partially visible blue lake in the background. In the foreground, three bighorn sheep are present, standing on a snowy slope. The central focus is on two of the sheep interacting closely: one adult bighorn sheep with large, curved horns is nuzzling or gently touching noses with a younger, smaller bighorn sheep that has shorter, less developed horns.
